verdict.rationale: The only exec-like evidence is that Khoj 'can generate and run simple Python code' for data analysis, plots and reports. Nothing shows it running shell commands or editing files on the user's machine, so this code-interpreter feature is adjacent to the story, not a real computer-control exec surface. Everything else in the pack covers chat, search and indexing of shared files, which is read and sync behavior, not file editing.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can run commands and edit files on my machine — a real exec surface, not just chat about what to do
